name: My Girlfriend Wants a Threesome! (I Just Hope It's with Me)
source:
Nick is driving around the city with his girlfriend Jenny, who suddenly suggests a threesome! The protagonist is nervous at first because of how calmly his girlfriend suggested it... And he never imagined the world of opportunities that the proposal would unleash!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/sieglinnde/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
尼克正载着女友珍妮在城里兜风，珍妮却冷不防提出想要来一场三人行！女友提出这个建议时过于平静的态度，起初让男主角忐忑不安……而他做梦也没想到，这番提议竟会开启怎样一个充满无限可能的新世界！

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/sieglinnde/about]Patreon[/url]]
